profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Freddie Mac with nearly 4 years of experience in software development, database management, and programming. Proficient in designing scalable applications, optimizing SQL databases, and implementing efficient coding practices. Experienced in collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Delivered a UI product meeting all business requirements using Angular
• Implemented seamless data mapping through API calls from the Java backend
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to resolve defects efficiently
• Supported sprints by assisting with builds, development tasks, and workflow optimization
• Diagnosed and resolved production, UAT, and performance issues using Kiali for service tracing and Kibana for log analysis, improving system reliability and performance
positions.insights: Agile Testing, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +19 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Completed Java core which mainly focused on studying Java, HTML/CSS, Javascript, and SQL
• Worked on a project to create a single page website using Angular and Node.js

positions.title: Developer Internship
positions.description:
• Used agile methodology to work with a team to create a web application to extract and manage
Virginia Legislative data using Django and Python
• Used BeautifulSoup to extract and validate the webpage’s data to ensure correctness
• Displayed a result of visualizations and a table using Javascript after submission through web userinterface
• Documented a weekly report for the project in order to record what our team was working on for
each week
• Created a dashboard where it prompts the user to enter inputs and display the result with two
different visualization

projects.title: GMU Appointment Management System
projects.description:
• Formed a UML diagram of needed components such as instance variables, methods, and abstract classes 
• Created an efficient solution using Java for GMU Hair Salon that allowed clients to book their appointments through the new application, by gathering their personal information and payment information
• Encapsulated all information deemed to be sensitive and used DDC along with implementation class to gather input from user
• Validated inputs from users in data definition class and repromoted users until the correct value was gathered

projects.title: GMU Personal Webpage
projects.description:
• Created a personal website using PHP that contains several functions in each page; calculating a final grade, booking an appointment, adding contact information, and searching a specific data in a text file
• Presented data values in ascending/descending order upon a user request
• Restricted a user from commenting more than once in both text file and database
• Validated user inputs with prompting an error message in a specific page
